system.description:
Mask Bearers spend much time in the terrible heat of the forges beating out wicked blades and unyielding armor. Using this skill, the Artificer may create weapons or armor.

Obstacles: Knives, Ob 1. Hammer, axe and sword, Ob 2. Spear and polearm, Ob 3. Arbalest, Ob 4. Bolts for crossbows and arbalests are Ob 2. You may do the following once per weapon: +1 VA—Ob=current VA plus 1. Add balance die, +2 Ob. +1 power—Ob=current weapon pow. Pot helmet, Ob 1. Light mail armor, Ob 2. Heavy mail armor, Ob 3. Plated mail, Ob 4. To make armor or shields “Dwarven-made” (reroll one 1 once), add +1 Ob. To make armor superior quality (reroll all 1s all the time), add +3 Ob. To create gray shade devices, the Artificer must have a gray skill—either via a temporary Epiphany or due to his actual shade.

FoRKs: Black-Metal Artifice

Skill Type: Craftsman. Tools: Workshop.

Restrictions: Dwarves only

Root: Will/Agi (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 307
